title: Project Planning Workspace Definition
purpose: Create the Project_Profile and Project_Roadmap from the approved Project Intake outputs.
requiredInputs: Repository review findings when reconciliation was triggered
completionBoundary: Project Planning completes only after both Project_Profile and Project_Roadmap have matching Approved dispositions. Approval of only one document cannot advance the lifecycle.
authorityBoundary: No separate planning bundle approval artifact
No browser-chat authority over repository documents
No independent approval authority for either planning document
No approval queue, route token, role gate, or execution-run authority
